name: grokbot
description: Universal Grok & Grok Bot orchestrator: multi-account pooling, automatic failover, and token-efficient export.

interface.longDescription: Query Grok through your configured account pool, inspect pool status, and export your available conversation history. The plugin runs its bundled Node.js MCP server locally and exposes grok_ask, grok_pool_status and grok_export. It requires Node.js 20 or later and your own Grok account configuration; optional vault references use an authenticated 1Password CLI. Local configuration, browser sessions and credentials are not bundled. This is an independent integration.
defaultPrompt: Show the status of my configured Grok account pool.
Ask Grok to explain the technical question I provide.
Export my available Grok conversation history as Markdown.
